principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class directly checks the types of provided shapes to calculate their area, meaning any new shape introduced requires modifying this method.
principle_violations.suggestion: Utilize polymorphism by defining a common interface or base class for all shapes that includes a method to calculate the area, making it extendable for new shapes without altering the AreaCalculator.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. The `AreaCalculator` class can benefit from adhering to the Open/Closed principle by implementing polymorphism for shape area calculation.
